This small static TTF is a HarfBuzz subset of Noto Sans JP Regular for the offline fallback-font rendering test. It contains the Japanese and Latin characters needed by that fixture; it is not a general-purpose font download.

Source: the official Google Fonts static TTF URL for Noto Sans JP / 400 in `src/fonts/google-font-catalog.json` (retrieved 2026-09-14). The original family and style names are retained. See `NotoSansJP-OFL.txt` for the license.
